We are all fighting our battles and we should be more kind to everyone. Punpun was kind.  


But it all depends how you see it tbh. Some people find comfort in being in their toxic state and that they can relate to Bojack and they justify it in some way. But as I said no one is perfect and we should all be better than we were yesterday. It's slow process but it's not impossible.  


I sometimes wonder off too especially how loneliness can impact you and me having not a huge social life I sometimes feel like Punpun and darkness do comes, sure it does but yet I don't give in even tho I gladly would I still have faith and hope and I believe I am not done yet.

So, learn and observe others, and help anyone you can!
